races.race_name: TRM Ironxcell For Energy Race

runners.name: Likedbymike
runners.spotlight: Sole win in 20 starts came in Cork maiden in October 2024, but has been in excellent form this year in sprints, including runner-up efforts in Listed company over C&D (behind Mission Central) and Cork; never involved here 12 days ago, but type to bounce back and enjoys this track; the one to beat.
runners.comment: Below form lto in Listed; solid runs in sprints prior; leading chance and enjoys track
runners.owner: Mrs Michael J Byrne & Jerry P Murphy

runners.name: Focaccia
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the sixth attempt when scoring at Bellewstown (5f, good) last month, beating Sparky Sparky bu 2.75l; a mark of 75 seemed to sum her up the last twice, however, so more needed here.
runners.comment: Bellewstown maiden winner; ran to rating last twice and needs a step forward here

runners.name: Michael's Well
runners.spotlight: Good second on debut over C&D in October before going one better at Navan (6f, soft) ten days later; needed return at Cork and ran okay in premier handicap over C&D 86 days ago; could figure if stepping forward again.
runners.comment: Good C&D second on debut; Navan maiden winner; poor on return but better lto; could figure

runners.name: Bear On The Run
runners.spotlight: Produced a promising debut when fifth in strong Curragh maiden in May 2025 before going one better in excellent style when easily scoring at Dundalk by 3.25l; looked potentially very useful that day and a leading player, but has been off for nearly a year.
runners.comment: Cosy winner of 6f AW maiden; promising sort who should go close,  but has been off a year
runners.owner: Kildare Racing Syndicate & Kilmichael Racing Syndicate

runners.name: Port Arthur
runners.spotlight: Solid runs in 6f maidens here and at the Curragh last year, finishing third and fourth; showed plenty of pace, but plenty to find after 291 days on the sideline.
runners.comment: Solid runs when third and fourth in 6f maidens last year; bit to find after 291 days off
runners.owner: Joseph E Keeling & Aidan Gleeson & M C Grassick

runners.name: Tolebi
runners.spotlight: 7f winner in France; couple of solid runs for this yard, most notably when beaten 4l into fourth at Fairyhouse (7f, gd) in June; below that last twice, but has the rating to be involved and drop back in trip should suit.
runners.comment: 7f winner in France; couple of solid runs for this yard; drop back in trip should suit

races.race_name: Matchbook Betting Exchange Handicap

runners.name: Lohoobb
runners.spotlight: Too Darn Hot colt with nice page was bought for 35,000gns last mointh; maiden after seven starts for Owen Burrows (beaten favourite all four handicap starts this term); touched off over 6f at Ffos Las when last seen in June.
runners.comment: Too Darn Hot colt was bought for 35,000gns last month; touched off over 6f when last seen

runners.name: Gavoo
runners.spotlight: Dual winner over this trip last year and promising fourth over C&D on his return; not so good next twice, but decent fifth of 20 in Scurry Handicap (extended 6f) at the Curragh where couldn't go the pace at halfway before keeping on late; had three of these behind and it was a creditable showing on first start against his elders.
runners.comment: Fifth of 20 in Scurry Handicap (extended 6f) at the Curragh, with three of these behind

runners.name: Smoke Them Out
runners.spotlight: Has okay form on good and Polytrack, and goes well on straight tracks, but last couple of wins have been on testing terrain; outstayed over 7f when second at Cork, and 5f was a bit sharp latest; all three wins have been at 6f.
runners.comment: Goes well on straight tracks, but last couple of wins have been on testing terrain

runners.name: Red Evolution
runners.spotlight: All three wins over 5f, including pair of Cork handicaps last summer; didn't threaten in valuable Curragh handicaps last twice, including over extended 6f last month; tongue-tie.
runners.comment: All three wins over 5f, including pair of Cork handicaps last summer; below par this term

runners.name: Spodo Komodo
runners.spotlight: Won a 6f Curragh maiden on yielding to soft last year; came on from reappearance when touched off by a subsequent Galway winner over 7f here; carries head high, and did so in that Curragh win, so that's just him and seems to give his all.
runners.comment: Touched off by subsequent Galway winner over 7f here; carries head high, but tries hard

runners.name: Clonmacash
runners.spotlight: Wins in his turn, albeit five of his six victories have been on AW; below par at Ayr last time, but solid runs in 6f turf handicaps earlier in the summer; this is start number 16 of the year.
runners.comment: Five of six wins have been on AW, but solid runs in 6f turf handicaps until latest outing

runners.name: Leveraging
runners.spotlight: Won AW maiden over this trip on fourth start in December; 66s, short-lived appearance in the front rank before fading tamely in the Scurry; best watched for now.
runners.comment: 66s, short-lived appearance in the front rank before fading tamely in the Scurry

runners.name: Amiata
runners.spotlight: Solid 3yo sprinter hasn't been hit hard for handicap wins over C&D in April and over 5f at the Curragh in June; back from a two-month spell, and perhaps he'll just come on for this run.
runners.comment: Solid 3yo sprinter; has won handicaps over C&D and over 5f at the Curragh; two months off

runners.name: Moltophino
runners.spotlight: Just one win to his name, but has been second three times in five runs here; drops in grade after contesting premier handicaps at the Curragh (excuse two runs back) this season; drawn widest which is probably a slight negative, but it's all on the day as to which side they go at Naas; only 1lb higher than his winning mark.
runners.comment: Just one win to his name, but three seconds from five runs here; dropping in grade

runners.name: Flaming Rib
runners.spotlight: Classy performer back in the day; couple of okay runs over 7f for this yard, but was 8l behind Gotta Catch'em All over C&D when only a 6-1 poke; handicapper is giving him a chance, but visor needs to make an impact for him to be competitive.
runners.comment: Was 8l behind Gotta Catch'em All over C&D when only a 6-1 poke; visor needs to work

runners.name: Gotta Catch'em All
runners.spotlight: Was a long-standing maiden over middle distances, but dam was a capable sprinter and dropping him back to 6f in a pair of blinkers has done the trick; followed up breakthrough win at Navan when winning in only slightly lower grade here; prominent racer got an uncontested lead then, but might have more to offer nonetheless.
runners.comment: Dropping him back to 6f in a pair of blinkers has done the trick; might have more to offer
runners.owner: Mrs S Bury & Ralph Kelly & Odhran O'Neill & Thomas Cox

races.race_name: Matchbook Supporting Local Racing Apprentice Handicap

runners.name: Undefeatable
runners.spotlight: Sole win in 13 starts came in 6f Sligo handicap a year ago, scoring cosily by 2.5l; positive third on AW in September but below par on turf return 23 days ago; needs to come on for that dropped back in trip.
runners.comment: 6f Sligo winner off this mark last year; should come on for latest effort dropped in trip

runners.name: Steel Magnolia
runners.spotlight: Has been consistent without looking well treated this year; not beaten far by Platino Bianco here over 5f in June; short of room when beaten favourite at Bellewstown 31 days ago; each-way chance.
runners.comment: Consistent; good C&D fourth two starts ago; each-way chance off same mark

runners.name: Practical Move
runners.spotlight: Improved when fourth behind Dandy Land and Hot To Foxtrot at Down Royal last time on first start for this yard; should improve for that, but needs to reverse the form.
runners.comment: Wasn't beaten far into fourth by couple of these rivals lto; needs step forward to reverse

runners.name: Another Nice'day
runners.spotlight: Built on positive sixth over C&D to get off the mark at Navan (5f, good) 23 days ago, value for more than the 0.5l margin as idled when hitting the front; 10lb rise harsh, however, and needs another step forward to defy new mark.
runners.comment: Broke maiden at Navan lto, value for more than 0.5l margin; 10lb rise makes this tougher

runners.name: Star Allure
runners.spotlight: Produced a positive third in small field over 5f in Dundalk maiden in December; little to recommend since in three starts, including on turf at Sligo last time.
runners.comment: Positive run on AW over 5f in December; little to shout about in three starts since

runners.name: Platino Bianco
runners.spotlight: Landed 20-runner handicap over C&D in June off 4lb lower, beating Tawaazon by 0.5l; two solid fifths since, showed up well for a long way over 6f ten days ago; in the mix.
runners.comment: C&D winner off 4lb lower in June; two solid efforts since and should be in the mix

runners.name: Luminessa
runners.spotlight: Some mild promise in AW maidens, but no obvious signs she's ready strike off this mark in three handicap runs so far; blinkers go on down in trip.
runners.comment: Mild promise in maidens but no obvious signs she's ready to strike in h'caps; blinkers
runners.owner: Scott Sterling & Darragh Cuffe & Conor Keohane

runners.name: Hot To Foxtrot
runners.spotlight: Proving consistent in handicaps this year; handled drop back to 5f at Down Royal 17 days ago, coming home well to grab third behind Dandy Land; shaped well that day from a less than ideal position, so capable of turning the tables.
runners.comment: Finished well lto at Down Royal to grab third; shouldn't be far away

runners.name: Dandy Land
runners.spotlight: Improving in handicaps, keeping on to take third at Bellewstown before being beaten 0.75l by Viamonte at Down Royal 17 days ago; had some of his main rivals behind him that day, so should be in the mix off 2lb higher.
runners.comment: Solid places last twice; beaten 0.75l at Down Royal 17 days ago; big chance off 2lb higher

runners.name: Tawaazon
runners.spotlight: Nine-time winner, five on turf; latest win came here over 6f in May 2025 off 7lb higher; second over C&D here in June, faded late into fifth when beaten favourite here last month; slowly away when ninth at Curragh; not out of it.
runners.comment: Nine-time winner, five on turf; placed over C&D in June off this mark but well-held since

runners.name: Livingston Range
runners.spotlight: C&D winner three years ago; two positive runs when fourth over 6f earlier in the summer and not beaten far at Fairyhouse over same trip 33 days ago; drop back to 5f unsure to suit though, and  well held over C&D twice in the last year.
runners.comment: Made the frame three times over 6f this year but drop in trip unsure to suit

runners.name: Jackandthefox
runners.spotlight: 24-race maiden; has been consistent in the last year, making the frame on several occasions, including when fourth here over 6f last July; solid runs the last three times over 6f and 7f; mark seems to just about sum him up however, so needs drop in trip to bring improvement.
runners.comment: 24-race maiden but consistent of late without threatening; needs more down in trip

runners.name: Step Back In Time
runners.spotlight: Four-time winner has struggled since 6f Navan win in October; 7lb lower mark now, but needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: Struggled since Navan success in October; needs to bounce back, but mark sliding

runners.name: Caffu Zafeen
runners.spotlight: Placed three times in maidens in Britain two years ago; never figured in two handicap starts over 5f and 7f for this stable, so hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Never figured in two handicap starts for this stable; drops in trip and hard to fancy

runners.name: Reinforce
runners.spotlight: Back-to-back wins on good ground over 5f at Navan and Down Royal in summer of 2024; not been close to that form over last two years and continues to slide in the weights.
runners.comment: Continues to slide in weights but no sign of yet he's ready to exploit mark

races.race_name: Bet 20 Get 40 With Matchbook Handicap

runners.name: Sherekiya
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

races.race_name: Watch All Racing Live At Matchbook Handicap

runners.name: Daler
runners.spotlight: Solid and consistent, but has plenty of weight; 1m1f Leopardstown win came on soft, but his latest third back there over 1m2f was on good and he ran his race; has his chance, but Keane's preference for stablemate wouldn't encourage support.
runners.comment: Solid and consistent, but has plenty of weight and Keane prefers stablemate

runners.name: Diamond Exchange
runners.spotlight: AW maiden winner narrowly landed 1m2f Leopardstown handicap in May; held since, but that means she's only 2lb higher; in front of My Girl Grace at Killarney last month, but not hard to see that form being turned around.
runners.comment: Narrowly landed 1m2f Leopardstown handicap in May; held since, but now only 2lb higher
runners.owner: Bronsan Racing & H Redknapp & John Breslin

runners.name: Covert Legend
runners.spotlight: Ordinary form in Britain, just sole 1m AW win to his name; seasonal/stable debut fourth over 1m4f at the Curragh, in this grade, was very good (travelled well and stuck on well) and quite likely he 'bounced' eight days later at Carlisle; has tried different headgear and visor now goes; trainer seems adept at improving recruits.
runners.comment: Seasonal/stable debut fourth over 1m4f at the Curragh was promising and next run too soon

runners.name: Nakasero
runners.spotlight: Latest win was just under a year ago over 1m1f at Leopardstown, although twice went close on AW over the winter (at this trip and 1m4f); well held in two starts at Leopardstown this summer, although it was a hot race last time and this is more his level.
runners.comment: Well held in two starts at Leopardstown this summer, although it was a hot race last time
runners.owner: Mark E Phelan & Paul W Phelan

runners.name: Letiza
runners.spotlight: Mare has been around the houses and is now on trainer number five, but not had a pile of racing for her age; won over this trip off 70 last summer; was gambled-on second on first run of the year at Navan, where she finished well over 1m2f but couldn't peg back another one that was punted; had Genoah over 3l behind that day; big chance if she's gone the right way since.
runners.comment: Gambled-on second on first run of the year at Navan, where she finished well over 1m2f

runners.name: Hamiyan
runners.spotlight: Useful soft-ground form at two; Leopardstown fourth in first-time headgear has worked out well; was keeping on well then, but still has stamina to prove.
runners.comment: Leopardstown fourth over 1m in first-time headgear has worked out well; chance if he stays
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Pavilion End
runners.spotlight: Just 1m4f AW maiden win to his name and best over farther; had the run of the race when pipped over 1m6f at Fairyhouse, and readily opposed over this trip.
runners.comment: Had the run of the race when pipped over 1m6f at Fairyhouse, and opposable back in trip

runners.name: Genoah
runners.spotlight: Four wins at Dundalk, but winless on the grass; Curragh second suggested he might put that right, but laboured enough effort when favourite at Navan; looks held by Letiza on that running.
runners.comment: Four wins at Dundalk, but winless on turf; laboured enough effort when favourite at Navan

runners.name: My Girl Grace
runners.spotlight: Winning debut over 1m2f on soft ground at Leopardstown (third won at Galway); trainer felt she wanted farther after that, but couldn't land a blow when favourite for 11.5f handicap at Killarney; no pace that day and best to draw a line through it.
runners.comment: Winning debut over 1m2f at Leopardstown; couldn't land a blow over 11.5f at Killarney

runners.name: Enchanted Lady
runners.spotlight: Okay run in AW maiden, but was beaten around 20l in Ulster Oaks when 33s on handicap debut; in fairness, soft ground was probably to blame.
runners.comment: Beaten around 20l in Ulster Oaks on handicap debut, soft ground was probably to blame

runners.name: Big Dispute
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner at four and fairly ordinary maiden hurdler; lapped in his last two maidens but that 10l sixth to Enceladus (Royal Ascot handicap winner who followed up in Gordon Stakes last week) catches the eye; maybe it flatters him, but the market will be interesting.
runners.comment: 10l sixth to subsequent Group 3 winner Enceladus at Cork catches the eye; note the market

races.race_name: Irish EBF Ballyhane Stakes (Median Sires Series)

runners.name: Livenka
runners.spotlight: Third to subsequent Pattern winners on first two starts; made all over 6f at Fairyhouse, second won by a street next time and third ran well at Galway; gets 11lb from the top pair which is handy.
runners.comment: Third to subsequent Pattern winners on first two starts; made all over 6f at Fairyhouse

runners.name: Weekend Roar
runners.spotlight: Both runs over this trip; promising third at Salisbury and then won by two short-heads at Newmarket; form of his runs has, by and large, worked out and has potential for more; yard won this in 2023.
runners.comment: Form of his runs has worked out and has potential for more; yard won this in 2023.

runners.name: South Dakota
runners.spotlight: Good fourth in the Chesham (7f, form working out) on second start, but sluggish from the gates and turned over at odds-on over 1m at Killarney (probably not bad form either); 6f is hardly ideal, but a leading player all the same.
runners.comment: Good fourth in the Chesham (7f); slowly away when turned over at odds-on over 1m latest
runners.owner: M Tabor & D Smith & Mrs J Magnier & Westerberg

runners.name: Alpe d'Huez
runners.spotlight: All runs over this trip; odds-on for winning debut on AW; decent form when second in conditions contest at Epsom; was on wrong side in Windsor Castle, but that hardly excuses his dismal showing; gelded since and headgear goes on; races prominently.
runners.comment: Was on wrong side in Windsor Castle, but that hardly excuses his dismal showing; gelded

runners.name: Star Prospect
runners.spotlight: All runs over 5f; debut win at the Curragh was followed by an odds-on defeat here and made no impact in the Norfolk; did things right and was giving weight to the two who beat him at Cork last time, where he finished off quite well; might well get the extra furlong here.
runners.comment: All runs over 5f; was giving weight to the two who beat him at Cork last time

runners.name: Ranting Duke
runners.spotlight: Second in valuable 6f novice at York in May (only okay form), but was thrown out for whip misuse; too keen and weakened to finish in rear in 1m Listed contest here a month ago; gelded and visored; opposable
runners.comment: Second in valuable 6f novice at York, thrown out for whip misuse; well held over 1m latest

runners.name: Maeda Matsu
runners.spotlight: Dubawi Legend filly cost 50,000euroS as a yearling; half-sister to three winners including 7f Listed winner Bellosa and fair sprinter Salah Belle who won twice for this yard; dam 6f winner, out of French 7f 2yo Listed winner.
runners.comment: Dubawi Legend filly cost 50,000euros as a yearling; half-sister to three winners

runners.name: Starlit
runners.spotlight: Starman newcomer cost 38,000euros as a yearling; third foal; dam unplaced over 5f, closely related to French 1m/1m4f winner Bolt Of Thunder, half-sister to 5f-7f winner Classy Clarets, out of 6f winner.
runners.comment: Starman newcomer cost 38,000euros as a yearling; dam unplaced over 5f

runners.name: Lily Bear
runners.spotlight: Showed up well in a barrier trial here and was fancied for first of two 7f runs at Leoaprdstown, but was too keen even in a hood; no show last time.
runners.comment: Fancied for first of two 7f runs at Leoaprdstown, but was too keen; no show last time

runners.name: Eighteenth Smiles
runners.spotlight: Well-beaten third in 7f Galway nursery on Thursday; little chance at these weights.
runners.comment: Well-beaten third in 7f Galway nursery on Thursday; little chance at these weights

runners.name: El Domino
runners.spotlight: 22s, showed a bit of speed but ultimately well beaten over 6.5f at Leopardstown.
runners.comment: 22s, showed a bit of speed but ultimately well beaten over 6.5f at Leopardstown

runners.name: Anglesea Bridge
runners.spotlight: Both runs over 6f; Fairyhouse debut was fine, but being hampered at the start doesn't explain a lacklustre effort here; Livenka is the one for the yard, and he'll be just trying to nick a bit of prize money.
runners.comment: Both runs over 6f; Fairyhouse debut was fine, but lacklustre effort here since

races.race_name: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden

runners.name: Nautic Star
runners.spotlight: Made the frame in all five starts, beaten 2.5l into third off 75 in 1m handicap at the Curragh before running to a similar level when filling the same spot at the Curragh 16 days ago over 7f; consistent and experienced; should go close back up in trip.
runners.comment: Placed in last three, third in Curragh maiden lto; third off 75 in h'cap; experience edge
runners.owner: J Kirkland & Mrs J M Ryan

runners.name: Venosa
runners.spotlight: Best run at two came when beaten 4.5l into fifth by Diamond Necklace in Ingabelle Stakes (7f, good), albeit flattered by proximity to winner; beaten 6.25l into third in maiden at Galway in October on soft ground; used as pacemaker in Group 1 company last twice; obviously far calmer waters here, and her two-year-old form makes her the one to beat.
runners.comment: Pacemaker in G1s last twice; form from five starts last year makes her one to beat
runners.owner: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith

runners.name: Never The Same
runners.spotlight: Improved from debut, stepped up in trip after a break when fourth at the Curragh (7f, good-to-firm) 16 days ago, 1.25l behind Nautic Star; should appreciate this extra furlong on that evidence.
runners.comment: 1.5l behind Nautic Star at Curragh lto; up in trip should suit; first-string on jockey
runners.owner: Philip Antonacci & Mrs Paul Shanahan & Mrs John Magnier

runners.name: Xirivella
runners.spotlight: Some promise amid greenness when beaten 10l into sixth on debut at Naas 30 days ago; tongue-tie on; more of a long-term project.
runners.comment: Some promise amid greenness when sixth on debut; more of a long-term project

runners.name: Acula
runners.spotlight: Sea The Stars filly; half-sister to winners Starford (9.4f-1m3f inc Group 3; RPR 114) and Jack Sparowe (1m-1m3f inc AW; 80); dam 7f-1m4f winner (inc 2yo/Listed; 98), half-sister to useful 1m winner Laelaps, out of 1m3f-1m6f Flat and useful 2m hurdle winner; makes debut for in-form yard; second string on jockey bookings.
runners.comment: Sea The Stars filly, half-sister to yard's smart Starford; trainer in form; second-string

runners.name: Orellana
runners.spotlight: 13,000euros yearling by Bungle Inthejungle; dam placed 7f/1m AW (RPR 65), half-sister to French winners Harmless (7f 2yo/1m2f Listed), Ghabnah (1m) and Samuraj (6f-1m), is granddaughter of German 1m Listed winner.
runners.comment: Dam placed 7f/1m AW (RPR 65), half-sister to three French winners, inc Listed; debut

runners.name: Emiza
runners.spotlight: Blue Point filly; closely related to 1m winner Embiran (RPR 94), half-sister to winners Elamaz (French/Australian 1m/1m2f inc Listed; 113), Emaniya (Group-placed 1m 2yo; 103) and Ediyva (7f AW; 74); dam 7f winner (inc Group 3/AW; 106); well-bred type from good Aga Khan family; market support would be interesting.
runners.comment: Blue Point filly; half-sister to three winners, inc Listed winner Elamaz; dam G3 7f winner
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Zarenakarena
runners.spotlight: 4,000euros foal; Ribchester filly; half-sister to winners Starlight Dream (1m2f; RPR 93), Areana (10.5f; 72), Amethistos (Greek 6f/1m) and Abella (Slovakian 8.5f/1m6f); dam Italian Listed-placed 1m-1m2f winner.
runners.comment: Ribchester filly, cost 4,000euros as a foal; half-sister to four winners (6f-1m6f)

runners.name: Estrallita
runners.spotlight: 100,000euros foal (50,000euros vendor Y); second foal; half-sister to 1m4f winner Ledecky (RPR 86); dam 1m AW winner (Group-placed 1m4f; 99), closely related to Italian 1m7f Listed winner Fortunino, out of unraced close relation to 1m4f/1m6f Group 3 winner; yard 2-26 in maidens this year.
runners.comment: 100,000euros foal; half-sister to 1m4f winner (RPR 86); dam 1m AW winner (Group-placed)

runners.name: Terra Di Siena
runners.spotlight: Faded tamely on debut 52 days ago; drops in trip.
runners.comment: Faded tamely on debut 52 days ago; drops in trip

runners.name: Mardi Gras Queen
runners.spotlight: Well-bred filly, half-sister to yard's Grade 1 winner Aspen Grove; green when well held on debut over 7f on soft ground at Cork 121 days ago; likely improver up in trip but needs to.
runners.comment: Half-sister to yard's smart Aspen Grove; should improve from Cork debut but needs to

runners.name: Zesty Belle
runners.spotlight: Well held on first two starts on the AW; off 248 days; looks more one for handicaps.
runners.comment: Not without some promise on first two starts but more one for handicaps

runners.name: Whatsin The Stars
runners.spotlight: Huge odds and ran accordingly on debut nine days ago; hard to recommend.
runners.comment: Huge odds and ran accordingly on debut nine days ago; hard to recommend

runners.name: Sweetie Too
runners.spotlight: Well beaten on debut 63 days ago; unlikely to figure.
runners.comment: Well beaten on debut 63 days ago; unlikely to figure

runners.name: Shelton Spring
runners.spotlight: No impact on debut six days ago; claims far from obvious.
runners.comment: No impact on debut six days ago; claims far from obvious

runners.name: Sioux The Boss
runners.spotlight: Well-held on debut at Down Royal 66 days ago; likely to improve for that but needs far more in cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Well-held on debut at Down Royal 66 days ago; needs far more in cheekpieces
runners.owner: John G Hennessy & C Acheson & Mrs John Harrington

runners.name: My Girl Jersie
runners.spotlight: No indication she can win a maiden based on first three runs.
runners.comment: No indication she can win a maiden based on first three runs

runners.name: Dark Willow
runners.spotlight: Very modest sort based on 13 runs; can't make a case for.
runners.comment: Very modest sort based on 13 runs; can't make a case for

races.race_name: www.mourneabbeyoil.ie Mares Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Fraher Field
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner; 0-4 over hurdles and rated 104; fine run when second at Listowel in June (2m, yielding); weakened upped to 2m7f on latest; drop back in trip here is a plus; place chance if reproduces that Listowel effort.
runners.comment: Bumper winner, good second at Listowel in June, place chance with a repeat of that
runners.owner: John J Flynn, Pierce Flynn, Conor Lannen

runners.name: Belladaball
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the third attempt in bumpers in a Listed heat at Fairyhouse in April; weakened into an 8.5l fourth on hurdles debut at Kilbeggan 24 days ago; not discounted but needs to improve on that to win this.
runners.comment: Listed bumper winner in April, weakened into fourth on hurdles bow, more needed

runners.name: Emerald Enigma
runners.spotlight: Made it 2-2 in bumpers when scoring by a head at Punchestown in May; won on debut here by 0.75l; from a good jumping family and she's preferred by Paul Townend; may prove hard to beat.
runners.comment: Won bumper on debut here, followed up at Punchestown, preferred by Townend, big chance

runners.name: Golden Wings
runners.spotlight: Standout effort a staying on third at Punchestown in January (16.5f, sft-hvy); suffered overreach when pulled up at Limerick a month later; may have needed latest when well beaten here after 89 days off but others look more solid.
runners.comment: Decent third at Punchestown in Jan', may have needed latest, others look more solid

runners.name: Easter Bonnet
runners.spotlight: Punchestown bumper winner (2m, gd-yld) on debut in October; pulled up on heavy ground in Listed bumper at Navan a month later; raced too keenly when beaten favourite on hurdles bow at Punchestown; let backers down again when beaten 21l into fourth here on latest; overlooked by Townend.

runners.comment: Won mares' maiden point in March, hooded for hurdles debut, probably best watched

runners.name: Sea Limit

runners.comment: Beaten 26l in sole point to point start, best watched; reserve

runners.name: Flowing Fast

runners.comment: 0-7 in points, failed to complete in five of them, best watched here

runners.name: Wonderful Everyday
runners.spotlight: Punchestown bumper winner had no apparent excuses when beaten 32l on hurdling debut at Listowel last month; surely capable of better than that but overlooked by Townend.
runners.comment: Punchestown bumper winner, poor run on hurdles debut, overlooked by Townend

runners.name: Thelittleredfox
runners.spotlight: First reserve; no impact in a Killarney bumper when 150-1; unlikely winner on hurdles debut.

runners.name: Jolly d'Olivate
runners.spotlight: Point-to-point winner last November but lost way in that sphere subsequently and no impact in maiden hurdles at Downpatrick and Wexford; hard to fancy.

runners.comment: Tailed off in maiden hurdle here 24 days ago, may need more time

runners.comment: 80-1 and tailed off on debut at Listowel, put a line through

races.race_name: John O'Flynn Motors 110 Series Final Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Eastmore
runners.spotlight: Series of placed efforts (including twice here) rewarded by 2m1f Limerick win early last month under enterprising ride, kept wide and making all in beating Dairy Force an eased 15l (good); 12lb hike makes this a lot tougher and unlikely to be given such leeway this time.
runners.comment: Hammered Dairy Force at Limerick recently after making all, 12lb hike for that though

runners.name: Dairy Force
runners.spotlight: Kilbeggan maiden hurdle winner two years ago for Liam O'Brien; consistent this year but keeps finding one too good, including when chasing home 15l winner Eastmore at Limerick; another solid effort at Galway a week ago so has to remain in calculations; hold-up performer.
runners.comment: Solid form in defeat this year but hold-up performer consistently finds one too good

runners.name: In The Trenches
runners.spotlight: Finally made the breakthrough in 2m3f Downpatrick maiden in June (good) at the 35th attempt; most recently just okay effort at Kilbeggan back in handicap company; more needed.
runners.comment: Downpatrick maiden winner has to improve on most recent handicap effort at Kilbeggan

runners.name: Le Diablo
runners.spotlight: Won 2m1f Clonmel handicap in April (yielding) and mixed form since, notably third the last twice, at Wexford and when not quite getting home behind Max Meridius over 2m2f at Ballinrobe in a first-time tongue-tie.
runners.comment: Recent placings off this mark give him each-way claims again

runners.name: Max Meridius
runners.spotlight: Returned from Flat to get off the mark last month when well-supported in 2m2f Ballinrobe handicap hurdle, keen and taking wide course but seeing it out well from the last (Le Diablo third); 8lb rise but 5yo could still have more improvement in him.
runners.comment: Won well at Ballinrobe; 8lb rise but 5yo could still have more improvement in him

runners.name: Arctic Flame
runners.spotlight: Both wins have been on good ground, notably last month in 2m4f handicap here, surviving stewards enquiry after hanging left on run-in and hampering second; up 6lb for that and cheekpieces now added to usual tongue-tie.
runners.comment: Hung left when winning here over 2m4f last month; 6lb higher and cheekpieces added

runners.name: Gino Bella
runners.spotlight: Point-to-point winner got off the mark hurdling at the 12th attempt when scoring over C&D last month, making much of running and finding plenty for pressure from last in a first-time hood; 7lb rise seems fair and another big run expected.
runners.comment: Hood brought improvement for recent C&D win; 7lb rise okay, big player

runners.name: Metamorpheus
runners.spotlight: Has mixed it between Flat and hurdles effectively this year, winning on the level at Sligo and only worn down close home in 2m Galway handicap hurdle on Saturday; obvious chance if turning out quickly.
runners.comment: Only worn down close home at Galway on Saturday; obvious chance if turning out again

runners.name: Midnight Eagle
runners.spotlight: Limerick win last year (for Aengus King) her sole success, but good run on most recent of two runs for current yard, clear of remainder when beaten 1l over this trip at Killarney last month (good); 4lb higher now but could go well.
runners.comment: Clear of rest when good second at Killarney recently; 4lb higher now but could go well

runners.name: Kilt
runners.spotlight: Flat winner won a 2m1f Wexford handicap hurdle in May (good-to-yielding) and okay runs twice since off 9lb higher; can be keen.
runners.comment: Wexford winner but improvement needed on two efforts since; keen sort

runners.name: Let's Go La Fichad
runners.spotlight: Improved significantly on better ground and reportedly settled better when getting up late to land 2m2f Sligo maiden in June; didn't land a meaningful blow on handicap debut at Galway a week ago, however, so lots more needed.
runners.comment: Didn't land a meaningful blow on handicap debut at Galway a week ago so lots more needed

runners.name: Quint Major
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner in 2024; 0-9 hurdling, most recently just behind a couple of today's rivals when seventh of 20 at Galway a week ago over this trip; has to improve to feature.
runners.comment: Behind a couple of today's rivals when 7th of 20 at Galway a week ago; has to improve

runners.name: Benzine
runners.spotlight: Maiden in all spheres after 22 starts, standout recent effort when second in 2m2f Limerick handicap chase; penultimate Clonmel handicap hurdle fourth has worked out well so certainly can't be ruled out.
runners.comment: Longstanding maiden but penultimate Clonmel 4th has worked out well so can't be ruled out

runners.name: Maxicourt
runners.spotlight: Maiden's best run came in C&D handicap last month when a staying on third of 23 (good); 2lb higher but can go well.
runners.comment: Recent C&D third a definite improvement; 2lb higher but can go well

runners.name: Redcliff Glen
runners.spotlight: Limerick handicap hurdle win came back in 2024 off 94; couple of ordinary efforts in May and has had time off since.
runners.comment: Modest strike-rate; couple of ordinary efforts in May and has had time off since

runners.name: Stily
runners.spotlight: Maiden in decent form last autumn over fences but pulled up on return to action in May; reverts to hurdles but hard to be confident in.
runners.comment: Pulled up on return to action in May; reverts to hurdles but hard to be confident in

runners.name: Leo Messy
runners.spotlight: Nothing as yet in four runs over hurdles, although attracted market support on handicap debut at Killarney last month, never counting in a first-time tongue-tie; may yet do better.
runners.comment: Market support but never counted on last month's handicap debut; may yet do better

runners.name: Highland Earl
runners.spotlight: Gained a first win at Wexford last summer off 81 (2m1f, good) and entitled to come on for last month's comeback run at Roscommon, albeit plenty to find with Syosset on that effort.
runners.comment: Entitled to come on for Roscommon comeback run, but plenty to find with Syosset

runners.name: Another Blunder
runners.spotlight: Huge odds and well beaten in all six starts; back in trip here for handicap debut but hard to make a case for.
runners.comment: Back in trip here for handicap debut but hard to make a case for

runners.comment: 4yo unknown quantity but worth a market check on handicap debut if getting a run; reserve

runners.comment: Has dropped a long way in the ratings but recent form none too encouraging; reserve
runners.owner: Mrs Helen Mullins & M J Lomax

runners.name: Syosset
runners.spotlight: AW winner last autumn has returned with a couple of solid runs in 2m handicap hurdles on good ground of late, third at Roscommon and kept on well from last to chase home a 3l winner at Wexford; 3lb higher now but definite player.
runners.comment: Two good runs in handicaps since returning; 3lb higher now but definite player

runners.name: Malbas
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; hurdles wins last year came at Fairyhouse and Kilbeggan on decent ground; yet to hit form this year however, well held at latter venue last month; blinkers now tried.
runners.comment: Yet to hit form this year; blinkers now tried; reserve

runners.name: Memories Maker

runners.comment: Handicap debutant for whom market probably best guide

runners.name: Codger's Rock
runners.spotlight: Standout run from five attempts hurdling when second in 2m Kilbeggan maiden in May, poor run there on latest however in first-time cheekpieces, blundering badly two out; opposable on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Kilbeggan maiden second ran badly there latest; opposable on handicap debut

runners.name: Vairue
runners.spotlight: Off for almost two years after winning at Thurles in 2022; returned from another long absence with mildly encouraging effort at Kilbeggan last month; entitled to improve for that and worth a market check off career-low mark.
runners.comment: Entitled to improve for recent comeback run and worth a market check off career-low mark

runners.name: Ikalimix
runners.spotlight: Mild bumper promise in Britain as a 5yo but interrupted hurdles campaign for current yard, absent since tailed off in Listowel maiden last September; likely best watched on handicap debut after such an absence, although encouraging jockey booking and worth a market check.
runners.comment: Likely best watched on handicap debut after long absence although worth a market check

runners.name: Scarlet Purse
runners.spotlight: 0-7 hurdling with John McConnell, absent since tailed off on heavy at Gowran in January; can only be watched on yard debut.
runners.comment: Absent since tailed off on heavy at Gowran in January; can only be watched on yard debut

runners.name: Clarin Breeze
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 5yo whose five runs have all been on much softer ground, pulled up on handicap debut in February when last seen; may improve for this better ground, market may give us a clue.
runners.comment: Lightly raced 5yo may improve for this better ground, market may give us a clue

runners.name: Ina Mina

runners.comment: Maiden hurdle form on heavy offered little but likely improver on handicap debut on good

runners.name: Nobody

runners.comment: Nothing as yet in handicaps, absent since January

runners.comment: Recent Kilbeggan third; not sure if drop in trip will suit but respected

runners.comment: Chase winner in May when last seen; one to consider now off 9lb lower hurdles mark

runners.comment: Two recent Kilbeggan runs not without merit; one to consider

runners.name: Tasmanian Girl
runners.spotlight: Won 2m Thurles handicap in March 2025 (good-to-yielding) but generally out of form under both codes this year, latest on last month's yard debut at Wexford when well-supported, having stumbled three out; could be capable of better judged on recent market support.
runners.comment: Supported on recent yard debut but things didn't go her way; improvement a possibility

runners.comment: Entitled to come on for recent comeback run; reserve

runners.comment: Promising second on Clonmel debut, won Kilbeggan bumper latest, obvious chance

runners.name: Master Sydney

runners.comment: Bumper winner, no joy on the Flat this season, others make more appeal

runners.name: Majestic Horizon

runners.name: Buachaill Jagoes

runners.comment: Beaten fav' when remote fourth in sole start in points, likely best watched here

runners.name: Woodie Wiley

runners.spotlight: Beaten 30l on debut at Kilbeggan; pulled up when 80-1 at Listowel on latest; hard to fancy.

runners.name: Champagne Diamond

runners.name: Diamond Tipp

runners.comment: No show in first two starts for this yard, PU here on latest, others more convincing

runners.comment: On long losing run, out of form this year, new blinkers need to transform

runners.name: Inthenickoftime

runners.comment: May have needed latest run at Clonmel, rated 13lb higher over fences, better expected now

runners.name: Jupiter Du Gite

runners.comment: Up 3lb for near miss at Killarney on latest, not sure this shorter trip is ideal; reserve

runners.name: Dictionary Corner
runners.spotlight: Minor promise in maidens but pulled up on handicap debut here last month and needs to leave that behind.
runners.comment: Minor promise in maidens, pulled up on handicap bow here last month, must rebound

runners.name: Crowsatedappletart

runners.comment: Won over fences at Wexford latest, rated 20lb lower in this sphere, can't discount
