runners.comment: Good second over fences at Tipperary, rated 9lb higher in this sphere, place shout again

runners.name: Scathach
runners.spotlight: First reserve; standout effort a 4.75l third in a Sligo mares' maiden hurdle in June; not a terrible run on handicap debut on latest at Kilbeggan and 1lb lower now; needs to build on that now.
runners.comment: Not a terrible run on handicap debut latest, needs to build on that now; reserve

runners.name: Boola Times
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose maiden; extended hurdles record to 0-8 at Tramore 11 days ago but it wasn't a bad run in third; was still beaten over 7l, however, so needs more off the same mark here with cheekpieces added.
runners.comment: Maiden beaten over 7l off this mark latest, needs more with cheekpieces now added

runners.name: Ballyminnion Boy
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; maiden pointer soundly beaten at huge odds in three maiden hurdles; best watched in first handicap unless money comes for him.
runners.comment: Maiden pointer, poor maiden hurdle form, watch unless market speaks; reserve

runners.name: Earl Neigh
runners.spotlight: Maiden has struggled in first two handicaps since returning from a break; beaten 50l on latest at Listowel; tongue tie and cheekpieces now tried.
runners.comment: Struggled in first two handicaps, beaten 50l on latest, tongue tie and cheekpieces added

runners.name: L'As de Watt
runners.spotlight: Best run in maidens came here over 2m (yielding) when a 5l second behind a now 130-rated rival; nowhere near that level twice since but could improve now switched to a handicap; market check advised.
runners.comment: Best maiden run came here, could improve for handicaps, check the market

runners.name: Calzaghi
runners.spotlight: Flat winner hasn't shown much in three maiden hurdles but this is more suitable; may improve and worth checking in the market on handicap hurdle debut.
runners.comment: Flat winner, modest maiden form, potential improver, market can guide in first h'cap

runners.name: Alentejo
runners.spotlight: One okay run on the Flat for William Haggas; big odds and down field in three maiden hurdles for this yard; can only watch in first handicap hurdle.
runners.comment: Big odds and down the field in three maiden hurdles, best watched in first h'cap

runners.name: Palace Boy
runners.spotlight: Flat and hurdles winner in Britain made a modest start for this yard in a Clonmel handicap hurdle in April and has been off since; can only be watched in first-time blinkers unless the market speaks.
runners.comment: Modest start for this yard at Clonmel, can only watch unless the market speaks

runners.name: King Ferdinand
runners.spotlight: Veteran hasn't won since August 2024; pulled up and beaten 48l in two starts since returning from a mammoth layoff; others make more appeal.
runners.comment: No win since 2024, two poor runs since return from mammoth layoff, hard to fancy

runners.name: Certamen
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose maiden yet to trouble the judge in either code; okay efforts in Flat maidens the last twice but not obviously well treated for handicap debut; tongue tie goes on; watch unless money comes.
runners.comment: Maiden, tongue tie on for handicap debut, not obviously well treated, watch unless backed

runners.name: Folly Beach
runners.spotlight: 0-13 over hurdles; ran on well for fourth on the Flat at Leopardstown (1m7f, good) on latest; well held on last start in this sphere at Galway just over a year ago but has placed off higher marks before so not discounted back over hurdles.
runners.comment: 0-13 over hurdles, decent run on the Flat latest, not discounted back over timber

runners.name: Champagne Dawn
runners.spotlight: C&D maiden hurdle winner at this meeting in 2024; has shown virtually nothing since and was pulled up after losing action in first-time visor (discarded) when last sighted at Wexford in October.
runners.comment: Shown nothing since maiden win at this meeting in 2024, pulled up when last seen in Oct'

races.race_name: Curragh To Curragh Charity Cycle On Saturday August 29th INH Flat Race

runners.name: Echoes Of Jane
runners.spotlight: Signs of ability in point-to-points and in both bumpers, third at Listowel and just denied at Killarney last month (good), having travelled well but not finding as much as looked likely; tongue-tie added to hood now.
runners.comment: Just denied at Killarney recently; tongue-tie added to hood now; definite claims

runners.name: Tale Of Intrigue
runners.spotlight: Nice Newtown Anner Flat pedigree but Fascinating Rock gelding cost buttons at two; steady improvement in four bumpers, notably Kilbeggan third, most recently never nearer fourth (beaten under 3l) at Wexford last month on good ground; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Recent placings at Kilbeggan and Wexford get him on to the shortlist

runners.name: S T Hamo
runners.spotlight: Recent Killarney fourth, in this headgear combination, represented an improvement; more likely required but definite place claims.
runners.comment: Recent Killarney fourth an improvement; definite place claims

runners.name: Bonnie Loch
runners.spotlight: Idaho mare is fourth foal; dam runner-up in points/placed 2m3f hurdle, from family of useful staying chaser Dakyns Boy; newcomer best watched.
runners.comment: Newcomer best watched

runners.name: Cloudy Rosie
runners.spotlight: Cloudings mare is sister to point-to-point winner Pluto's Gate, half-sister to four winners inc Geordie B (bumper and useful 2m7f-3m hurdle/chase), Amber Flush (2m7f/3m1f hurdle) and Lazy Sunday (2m3f-3m chase); dam 2m1f hurdle winner; placed in all three point-to-points last season.
runners.comment: Placed in all three point-to-points last season

runners.name: Awaywego
runners.spotlight: Getaway 5yo cost 37,000euros as a foal and 19,000euros as a 3yo; first foal; dam bumper and 2m-2m2f hurdle/chase winner, sister to useful hurdle/chase winners Minella Foru (2m-3m) and Sumkindofking (2m-3m2f); noteworthy jockey booking for debut, worth a market check.
runners.comment: Dam won a bumper; noteworthy jockey booking, worth a market check on debut

runners.name: Blackwood Joe
runners.spotlight: Kingston Hill 5yo is second foal; dam placed in bumper/2m5f hurdle, half-sister to 2m4f-3m1f hurdle/chase winner Better Days; debutant probably best watched unless market speaks in his favour.
runners.comment: Debutant probably best watched unless market speaks in his favour

runners.name: Gagaistheboss
runners.spotlight: Maxios half-brother to 2m4f hurdle winner Twin Power; dam useful 2m-3m hurdle/chase winner, sister to useful 2m-3m hurdle/chase winner Connectivity; newcomer has to be watched for market support.
runners.comment: Half-brother to 2m4f hurdle winner Twin Power; newcomer to be watched for market support

runners.name: Rinnaseer Beauty
runners.spotlight: Maxios 4yo cost 3,000euros as a foal; dam placed 8.5f-1m4f (RPR 71), half-sister to useful sprinters Doc Sportello and Bagamoyo; blinkered on debut, likely best watched.
runners.comment: Cheaply bought Maxios gelding blinkered on debut, likely best watched

runners.name: Poet's Sonnet
runners.spotlight: Poet's Word half-brother to point winner; dam hunter chase/prolific point winner; disappointing favourite in Dromahane point-to-point last November; missed intended bumper debut last month due to good ground so likely will want rain.
runners.comment: Missed intended bumper debut last month due to good ground so likely will want rain

runners.name: Red Shea
runners.spotlight: Crystal Ocean half-brother to four winners inc Annie Angel (useful 2m4f-3m chase), Myztique (bumper/2m2f hurdle) and Krujers Girl (2m3f-2m7f chase); dam unraced sister to useful 2m4f-3m2f hurdler/chaser Dun Doire; jockey booking encouraging, worth a market check on debut.
runners.comment: Nicely bred newcomer worth a market check with Harry Swan booked

runners.name: Free A Minute
runners.spotlight: Maiden in point-to-points and well held on rules debut in Punchestown maiden hurdle in June; switches to bumper and can only be watched.
runners.comment: Well held in Punchestown maiden hurdle in June; switches to bumper and can only be watched

runners.name: Green Style
runners.spotlight: 35,000euros 3yo; half-brother to winners Mr Muldoon (useful hurdler/chaser) and Rajjamataz; dam points' winner; won Oldcastle point-to-point in March 2025 and following month ran well for a long way when creditable sixth of 18 in very valuable Goffs Defender Bumper at Punchestown festival for Stuart Crawford; reappears here for top yard and likely major player.
runners.comment: Goffs Bumper sixth over a year ago; reappears for top yard and likely major player

runners.name: Merci Vieil Ami
runners.spotlight: Diamond Boy half-brother to three winners in France, including useful 2m1f-2m4f hurdler/chaser Le But; dam Flat/hurdles winner; ran twice in point-to-points before never counting in Ballinrobe bumper last month.
runners.comment: Ran twice in point-to-points before never counting in Ballinrobe bumper last month

runners.name: Cloneen To The Max
runners.spotlight: Point-to-point winner but form in bumpers and maiden hurdles modest.
runners.comment: Point-to-point winner but form in bumpers and maiden hurdles modest

runners.name: Hoof And Hustle
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to bumper winner Pectora; dam unraced half-sister to smart bumper/2m hurdler Spirit Leader; soundly beaten on Leopardstown debut at Christmas, returning in May when didn't count, having raced keenly, at Clonmel; seems best watched.
runners.comment: Too keen at Clonmel latest; seems best watched

runners.name: It's Buster's Way
runners.spotlight: Doyen gelding; 21,000euros foal; dam unraced half-sister to high-class 2m-2m4f hurdler/chaser Kalashnikov; soon beaten on Punchestown debut in June when a 33-1 shot; eyecatching jockey booking now so worth a market check.
runners.comment: Soon beaten on Punchestown debut in June; eyecatching jockey booking now though

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: War Gaming
runners.spotlight: Solid form when placed in his two runs so far; first-time blinkers replace cheekpieces and he should be suited by stepping back up to 6f; looks the main danger.
runners.comment: Solid form when placed in his two runs so far; looks the main danger

runners.name: The Mean Fiddler
runners.spotlight: A 200,000gns breeze-up buy, he ran a stormer when beaten a nose on his debut at Pontefract (5f, good to firm) eight days ago, looking a winner-in-waiting; steps up in trip and should be hard to beat.
runners.comment: Ran a stormer when beaten a nose on his debut at Pontefract eight days ago

runners.name: Reflect On Glory
runners.spotlight: Made an encouraging debut when third of seven in a similar contest over C&D (good to firm) last Monday; can be expected to show improvement which is more than likely required here.
runners.comment: Made an encouraging debut when third of seven in a similar contest over C&D last Monday

runners.name: Sole Ruler
runners.spotlight: Has shown just a modest level of ability in his two runs so far and has his work cut out here; his best chance of success in the immediate future probably lies in nurseries.
runners.comment: Has shown just a modest level of ability in his two runs so far

races.race_name: Napoleons Casino And Restaurant Leeds Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Queen Sana
runners.spotlight: 11-race maiden who has finished second six times; needs to prove she can get the job done and it's possible that 5f is her optimum trip, but she has the best form in the field and this could be a good opportunity.
runners.comment: 11-race maiden who needs to prove she can get the job done, but she has the best form

runners.name: Secret Harvest
runners.spotlight: Went very close at 50-1 on debut at Leicester (6f, good to firm) in May; failed to back that up at Bath (5.7f, good) but she lost a shoe and has had a break since; remains of interest.
runners.comment: Went very close at 50-1 on debut; failed to back it up at Bath but remains of interest

runners.name: Royale Union
runners.spotlight: Signs of promise on debut at Southwell last month (7f, AW; slowly away) and likewise when 4l third of seven at Redcar (7f, good to firm) last Wednesday; her useful pedigree hints that this drop in trip could be a positive, and she's firmly in calculations.
runners.comment: Promise on both starts and this drop in trip could be a positive; firmly in calculations

runners.name: Rohini
runners.spotlight: One to watch in the betting in first-time cheekpieces but she's been beaten a long way on all five starts, for this stable on her last two runs.
runners.comment: One to watch in the market in first-time cheekpieces but beaten a long way on all 5 starts

runners.name: Aurora's Doublesix
runners.spotlight: 4yo who has achieved very little across her 17 winless starts and others are preferred.
runners.comment: 4yo who has achieved very little across her 17 winless starts and others are preferred

runners.name: All Good
runners.spotlight: Her dam was a 5f/6f winner for the yard (RPR 77) and it's very early days, but she was soundly beaten at big prices last autumn on her first two starts (6f/5f, AW) and this is her first outing since; improvement needed.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten last autumn on her first two starts and absent since; improvement needed

races.race_name: Weatherbys Bloodstock Pro Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Zoustar Dreams
runners.spotlight: Progressive since these cheekpieces went on, winning two in a row (6f/5f, good to firm/soft) before fading into fourth at Newmarket (6f, good to firm), and she appreciated the return to 5f when winning at Nottingham (5f, good to firm) last time; did it nicely and a 5lb rise may not stop her.
runners.comment: Made it 3-4 in cheekpieces when doing it nicely at Nottingham; 5lb rise may not stop her

runners.name: Creative Queen
runners.spotlight: Made all in a novice at Yarmouth (6f, soft) in May in first-time blinkers; merely seventh subsequently in her first two handicaps (7f/6f, good to firm) but she showed plenty of pace over 6f at Carlisle on the second occasion and could relish this first crack at 5f; cheekpieces replace blinkers.
runners.comment: Showed plenty of pace over 6f at Carlisle last time & could relish this first crack at 5f

runners.name: Marajito
runners.spotlight: Won over C&D (good) in May and perhaps the return to Ripon will be a positive; however, she's been unplaced on her three starts since, most recently fourth to Zoustar Dreams at Nottingham, and she needs something extra.
runners.comment: Won over C&D in May but unplaced elsewhere on her three runs since; needs something extra

runners.name: Angel Numbers
runners.spotlight: She'd run some good races in defeat this year for the Newland/Insole yard prior to being sold for 12,000gns last month, and she exploited a reduced mark on her stable debut at Thirsk (5f, good to firm); she had just a neck to spare and is back up 4lb but could have more to offer for the yard.
runners.comment: Won by a neck on stable debut at Thirsk last month and could have more to offer for yard
runners.owner: Grange Park Racing Xviii And Ruth Carr

runners.name: North West Gal
runners.spotlight: Won Newcastle maiden (5f, AW) last November on final 2yo start; close fifth on reappearance at Catterick (6f, good) in May before heavy defeat here later that month (6f, good; failed to settle); the drop back to 5f could help and she's not written off, but others arrive with less to prove.
runners.comment: Heavy defeat here last time; lightly raced and not written off but has something to prove

races.race_name: Wilmot-Smith Memorial Handicap

runners.name: Saint Lawrence
runners.spotlight: Having dropped down the weights he was a good second on his seasonal and stable debut at Ascot (6f, good) in May; however, two lesser runs have followed and this 8yo remains without a win since June 2023.
runners.comment: Good second on reappearance in May, but two lesser efforts since and losing run continues

runners.name: Dark Cloud Rising
runners.spotlight: Stumbled/unseated in first-time visor (retained since) at Carlisle in May but posted a career-best when winning by 2l over C&D (good) in June, and he was denied a clear run when third of six at Pontefract (6f, good) subsequently; high on the list.
runners.comment: Won by 2l over C&D in June and denied a clear run when third at Pontefract since

runners.name: Lord Roxby
runners.spotlight: Won in a big field at York (6f, good) in May and he's continued in good form, finishing second at Ayr (6f, good to firm) last time; key player.
runners.comment: Won in a big field at York in May and has continued in good form; key player
runners.owner: N Skinner D Jenkins J Glover

runners.name: Grant Wood
runners.spotlight: C&D winner who won two in a row at Newcastle (AW) at the start of the year and was a close third over C&D (good) in May; he's dropped back down to a handy mark but has finished down the field on his last three outings.
runners.comment: Close third over C&D in May off 5lb higher, but down the field on his last three outings

runners.name: Rousing Encore
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent and winless this year and well beaten at York (6f, good to firm) recently; however, that was more competitive than this and two starts ago he ran well when third of 17 at Ayr (6f, good); may have a chance.
runners.comment: Inconsistent this year and well beaten last time but good third of 17 at Ayr previously

runners.name: Boston Dan
runners.spotlight: 2yo Listed runner-up last October; fourth of seven on stable debut at Chester (6f, good) nine days ago, which was a step back in the right direction, but he needs another today if he's to pose a serious threat.
runners.comment: Step back in right direction on recent stable debut but he needs another today

runners.name: Commanche Falls
runners.spotlight: Runner-up twice in a row in Bahrain (6f, good/good to firm) in January; this 9yo hasn't shone on his three starts since and his losing sequence goes back to September 2023, but perhaps the drop back in grade will trigger a revival for this C&D winner; not ruled out.
runners.comment: 9yo whose losing run continues but the drop back in grade could trigger a revival
runners.owner: Doug Graham, Ian Davison, Alan Drysdale

races.race_name: North Yorkshire Ice Cream Championship 2026 Handicap

runners.name: Poet's Dawn
runners.spotlight: 11yo who is a three-time C&D winner, the latest last month (good), and he followed up at Nottingham (1m2f, good to firm) last Thursday in a novice amateur riders' race, for which he carries a 4lb penalty here; third in the last three runnings of this race and could better that position today.
runners.comment: 11yo who is a three-time C&D winner and arrives on a hat-trick; in calculations

runners.name: Mao Shang Wong
runners.spotlight: Won at Beverley (1m2f, good to firm) in May and second of five there (1m2f, good to firm) last month, but he was beaten 4l and has finished down the field either side of that penultimate start; others have more pressing claims.
runners.comment: Won at Beverley in May but mixed form since and others have more pressing claims

runners.name: His Finest Hour
runners.spotlight: Won for Ian Williams at Newbury (1m2f, good to firm) last July and runner-up three times subsequently; sold for 20,000gns last October and absent since (wind op in interim); may be best watched on stable debut.
runners.comment: Good campaign last season; sold for 20,000gns; makes stable debut after absence

runners.name: Polygram
runners.spotlight: Close second of five at Ayr (1m2f, good to firm) last month before getting off the mark at the 16th attempt at Pontefract (1m, good to firm) eight days ago; had something to spare and she's respected under a penalty.
runners.comment: Off mark at 16th attempt at Pontefract latest; something to spare; respected under penalty

runners.name: Everyoneknowsadave
runners.spotlight: Placed twice in a row before winning by 2l at Nottingham (1m2f, good to firm) last month; he holds solid claims up 6lb for last time.
runners.comment: Placed twice in a row before 2l win at Nottingham; solid claims up 6lb for last time

races.race_name: Queen Ethelburga's Collegiate Handicap

runners.name: Hey Havana
runners.spotlight: Nine-race maiden but has made the frame five times, although his best efforts have been when second twice over 7f; holds place claims.
runners.comment: Nine-race maiden but has made the frame five times

runners.name: Vega's Virtue
runners.spotlight: Improved for the fitting of cheekpieces and the step up to 1m when scoring over C&D (good) in May; after two lesser efforts, she showed her liking for this track when landing her second C&D win (good) 16 days ago; handicapper has whacked her up 8lb but she cannot be dismissed around here.
runners.comment: Has scored twice over C&D this term; 8lb higher but cannot be dismissed around here

runners.name: Amber Hamur
runners.spotlight: Has shown improvement since joining current yard and stepping up to around 1m in two runs, getting off the mark at Hamilton (good) last month when making all; she should give another good account off 3lb higher.
runners.comment: Got off the mark at Hamilton last month when making all; should give another good account

runners.name: Dacres Cross
runners.spotlight: Hasn't built on his nursery success at Carlisle (6f, good) last August in six runs since; now 5lb lower and steps up in trip; also takes a drop in grade but has too many questions to answer.
runners.comment: Hasn't built on his nursery success at Carlisle last August in six runs since

runners.name: Itszaboy
runners.spotlight: Big prices and well beaten in three handicaps this year; dropping down the weights but hard to recommend.
runners.comment: Big prices and well beaten in three handicaps this year

runners.name: Scheffler
runners.spotlight: Promising third on his debut at Lingfield (7f, AW) in March when trained by Richard Hughes, but has run well below that level since; has finished last on two most recent runs for current trainer; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Third on his debut at Lingfield in March, but has run well below that level since

runners.name: Tago Mago
runners.spotlight: Fair third for Jamie Osborne on debut at Southwell last September; subsequently sold for 7,000gns; beaten 23l on stable debut at Wetherby (7f, good to firm) in June, and 24l at Wolverhampton (7f) last month; steps up in trip in first-time tongue-tie but she doesn't look ready to win.
runners.comment: Beaten 23l on stable debut at Wetherby in June, and 24l at Wolverhampton last month

runners.name: Sailor's Return
runners.spotlight: Ex-French; has shown just modest form in three runs for this yard over 7f; steps back up to 1m and improvement required.
runners.comment: Ex-French; has shown just modest form in three runs for this yard over 7f

races.race_name: Weatherbys Digital Solutions Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Yimmna
runners.spotlight: Needed the experienced on her debut and built on that when chasing home a long odds-on favourite, who's gone in again since, despite over-racing upped to 1m; should have more to offer.
runners.comment: Forward step last time, despite over-racing upped to 1m; should have more to offer

runners.name: Aura Champagne
runners.spotlight: Solid debut behind a couple of useful fillies last autumn but then wasn't seen again until a fortnight ago, when easy to back (1m2f); again finished third to a couple of useful fillies at Newbury and holds decent claims with that under her belt.
runners.comment: Third to a couple of useful fillies on return; holds fair claims with that under her belt

runners.name: Quisana
runners.spotlight: She's run to a similar level all four starts, often pulling hard, including in the first-time hood (retained) back up to 1m last time; leading claims if she settles but it's now hard to be bullish on that front.
runners.comment: Run to a similar level all four starts, often pulling hard; leading claims if she settles

runners.name: Moonlit Surf
runners.spotlight: Again inclined to pull hard in a C&D fillies' novice last time and no surprise to see a first-time hood fitted today; looking exposed now and will again be vulnerable to an improver, even if proving more amenable.
runners.comment: Exposed now and will again be vulnerable to an improver, even if more amenable in the hood

runners.name: Moontune
runners.spotlight: Second foal of a 7f 2yo winner for the Gosden yard (first offspring a winner in France and Spain); trainer gets the odd big-priced winning newcomer but she's likely one for handicaps down the line.
runners.comment: Trainer gets the odd big-priced winning newcomer; likely one for handicaps down the line

runners.name: My Prerogative
runners.spotlight: 50-1 when well held on her 6f Polytrack debut for Ed Walker last September; yard's Flat wins in recent times have all come with older horses and it would be a surprise to see her take this.
runners.comment: 50-1 when well held on her 6f Polytrack debut for Ed Walker last September

races.race_name: Weatherbys Global Stallions App EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Blue Sign
runners.spotlight: Big prices and well held in three runs to date (5f-7f), missing the break a couple of times; this is more realistic in a first-time tongue-tie but she again looks vulnerable.
runners.comment: Big prices & well held in three runs to date (5f-7f), missing the break a couple of times

runners.name: Lady Leora
runners.spotlight: 290,000euros yearling whose French-trained dam won on her 6f 2yo debut; trainer, who also saddles Harlequin Gift, has enjoyed a decent season with juveniles and she's an interesting newcomer.
runners.comment: 290,000euros yearling whose French-trained dam won on her 6f 2yo debut;  interesting

runners.name: Harlequin Gift
runners.spotlight: Well held after a slow start on her 6f debut, and again last time, when pulling hard in front over 7f and not seeing it out; nurseries may be her time to shine in due course.
runners.comment: Pulled hard in front over 7f latest; nurseries may be her time to shine in due course

runners.name: Casablanca Dream
runners.spotlight: May-foaled 55,000euros 2yo (Irish breeze-ups) who has stamina on the dam's side of her pedigree and is likely to be suited by more of a test in due course; stable had a big-priced 2yo newcomer win last week; watch the market.
runners.comment: 55,000euros 2yo; stable had a big-priced 2yo newcomer win last week; watch the market

runners.name: Mandolin Rain
runners.spotlight: 75,000euros 2yo (Irish breeze-ups) who's a sister to Irish 2yo winner Ex Animo and a half-sister to Serenity Prayer (won on 3yo debut); the market will be the best guide.
runners.comment: 75,000euros 2yo (Irish breeze-ups); sister to Irish 2yo winner Ex Animo; market useful

runners.name: Piper Cee
runners.spotlight: April-foaled 30,000gns yearling who's a half-sister to a useful sprint winner (turf) in the US; trainer enjoying a fine summer with 2yos and the market is usually a reliable guide with his newcomers.
runners.comment: 30,000gns yearling; half-sister to a useful sprint winner in the US; the market will guide

runners.name: Lola De Valence
runners.spotlight: Stable in flying form of late, albeit mainly with older horses; this filly needed the experience on her Salisbury debut a fortnight ago, when well off the front pair; entitled to improve but needs to.
runners.comment: Needed the experience on her Salisbury debut a fortnight ago, when well off the front pair

races.race_name: Weatherbys VAT Services Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Harry's Pop
runners.spotlight: Gelded after hanging badly right on firm ground at Bath early last month; better effort in a Tapeta novice in which the leaders didn't come back 11 days ago and that gave something to build on.
runners.comment: Better run in race in which the leaders didn't come back latest gave something to build on
runners.owner: K Shenton, N Bradley 6 & D Cunha

runners.name: Leucothea
runners.spotlight: Three defeats at short prices in the spring, including in a seller, before out of her depth in the Super Sprint last time; this is more realistic on her nursery debut but she needs to find more.
runners.comment: This is more realistic on her nursery debut but she needs to find more

runners.name: Fern Clyde
runners.spotlight: Didn't see out a stiff 7.4f following her 6f maiden win, but then appeared to have no excuses on her nursery debut last time (first-time tongue-tie; retained); looking exposed now.
runners.comment: Appeared to have no excuses on her nursery debut; looking exposed now

runners.name: Mobadir
runners.spotlight: Last of six on his first two starts before never involved in a first-time hood (off here) a month ago; for all that, he's shown enough to be considered now handicapping having since been gelded for a yard among the winners.
runners.comment: Shown enough to be considered now h'capping (has been gelded) for a yard among the winners

runners.name: Dissenter
runners.spotlight: Backed at prices ahead of her debut, for a yard not noted for 2yo newcomers, and showed the right attitude when off the mark at Chepstow ten days ago (both for Ashley Lewis, who's enjoying a purple patch); shortlisted on her nursery debut.
runners.comment: Right attitude when off the mark at Chepstow 10 days ago; shortlisted on her nursery debut

runners.name: Boleto
runners.spotlight: Pontefract win hasn't worked out and, having been out of his depth at Royal Ascot, he ran well below market expectations on his nursery debut a few weeks ago (buzzed up after getting crowded early); needs to settle better.
runners.comment: Below market expectations on his nursery debut a few weeks ago; needs to settle better

runners.name: Star People
runners.spotlight: Better with each start, culminating in a neck defeat in a match at Ayr two weeks ago, having been gelded; hard to know the worth of that, with his sole rival a newcomer, but he may have more to offer under Marco Ghiani, who's 2-4 for the yard.
runners.comment: Better with each start; may have more to offer under Marco Ghiani, who's 2-4 for the yard

races.race_name: weatherbysshop.co.uk Handicap

runners.name: Invincible Crown
runners.spotlight: Three-time Wolverhampton winner who finally broke his duck on turf off 3lb lower a month ago (went close over C&D previously); things didn't pan out his way at Catterick last time and he's one to consider.
runners.comment: Consistent; things didn't pan out his way at Catterick last time and he's one to consider
runners.owner: Grange Park Racing VIII & Mrs R Carr

runners.name: Up The Monk
runners.spotlight: AW regular who's achieved little in four runs on turf and goes in a new form of headgear (won for the visor first being fitted) on his first ever crack at 5f; will need to somewhat better his latest Thirsk effort.
runners.comment: New form of headgear; will need to somewhat better his latest Thirsk effort

runners.name: Star Marian
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent filly who's tried in first-time headgear back from two months off; excuses for two Wolverhampton defeats since her maiden win there in the spring (made all for Rossa Ryan) but she's achieved little in three runs on turf.
runners.comment: Inconsistent; tried in first-time headgear; achieved little in three runs on turf

runners.name: Hurt You Never
runners.spotlight: Prolific winner down the years, including over C&D last summer, who's regressed sharply in recent times; a few years since she ran at this low a level and that should help, but it will largely hinge on how she responds to wearing headgear for the first time.
runners.comment: Prolific winner down the years; one to consider at this level in first-time headgear

runners.name: Little Jaybee
runners.spotlight: Sharply regressive for Tom Ward this season, coming a stone down the weights; goes in first-time headgear for her new yard, back from a short break, and is worth tracking in the market.
runners.comment: Regressive; goes in first-time headgear for her new yard; worth tracking in the market
runners.owner: Mrs A L Lofts & Mrs Nicky Scott Knight

runners.name: Sergeant Mayer
runners.spotlight: A win and a near-miss to his name in two runs here; now 7lb lower than when winning last spring but he's struggled this season, including without the trademark cheekpieces last time; needs a revival but the drop back from 6f should help.
runners.comment: Struggled this season; needs a revival but the drop back from 6f should help

races.race_name: Weatherbys Bettrends Handicap

runners.name: Del Corso
runners.spotlight: Expensive to follow this season before being found a weak handicap over C&D last time, when always in control from the front; has only been nudged up 1lb for that and has a decent chance of following up.
runners.comment: Found a weak handicap over C&D last time; has a decent chance of following up

runners.name: Aussie Pearl
runners.spotlight: Poor effort on her comeback in June and another one off 3lb higher on her handicap debut last time, when a remote last of four; first-time headgear will need to make a difference.
runners.comment: Remote last of four on handicap debut; first-time headgear will need to make a difference

runners.name: Sedeirah
runners.spotlight: Dam won over this trip and the step up from 1m seems sure to suit on the evidence of three runs to date; looks to start handicap life on a workable mark and should have some improvement left in her.
runners.comment: The step up from 1m seems sure to suit and she should have some improvement left in her

runners.name: Dawn Of Liberation
runners.spotlight: Not as good now and has his share of off days; back on a winning mark, though, has a C&D win to his name and this is less competitive than he's used to returning from ten weeks off.
runners.comment: Back on a winning mark, boasts a C&D win and this is less competitive than he's used to

races.race_name: Weatherbys Racing Bank Handicap

runners.name: Venetian Lion
runners.spotlight: Gelded after three ordinary efforts in maidens in the spring; solid effort in the first-time tongue-tie off this mark at Southwell last Monday, when a clear second, and his claims are obvious off the same mark.
runners.comment: Clear second on handicap debut last Monday, and his claims are obvious off the same mark

runners.name: Pretty Spirited
runners.spotlight: Dual winner for the Frost yard this time last year, latterly off 3lb lower, but has been absent since pulling away her chances over C&D in the spring; needs a revival.
runners.comment: Absent since pulling away her chances over C&D in the spring; needs a revival for new yard
runners.owner: Dr M Voikhansky & Mrs S Voikhanskaya

runners.name: Straight A
runners.spotlight: Three-time Tapeta winner who's been expensive to follow in recent times; ridden more prominently than usual when below par last time but there have been too many near-misses for comfort.
runners.comment: Three-time Tapeta winner; there have been too many near-misses for comfort

runners.name: Theme Park
runners.spotlight: Serial slow starter who ended a losing run off a 4lb lower mark at Doncaster 11 days ago before bumping into a well-handicapped winner over C&D last Thursday; holds claims, especially if he can get away on terms for a change.
runners.comment: Serial slow starter who bumped into well-handicapped winner over C&D last Thursday; player

runners.name: G'Emmethegreenlite
runners.spotlight: He has only run in sprints to date, including when well beaten on his stable/handicap debut in April; the hood comes off and he's hard to include in calculations unless there's good money around.
runners.comment: Has only run in sprints to date; hard to include in calculations unless there's good money

runners.name: Symphony Of Joy
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent maiden who has missed the start and/or pulled hard; no problem with 9.5f on Tapeta last time, when turning in his best effort since handicapping (made most), but history suggests he's no good thing to build on it.
runners.comment: Inconsistent maiden who has missed the start and/or pulled hard; better last time (AW)

races.race_name: A1R Services Ltd Amateur Jockeys' Handicap

runners.name: Shahbaz
runners.spotlight: Patchy form since joining this yard and well behind I'd Go Maniac on his return from five months off at Epsom (1m4f, good to firm) 18 days ago, but is 9lb lower than when winning at Newbury (1m4f, good to firm) for Ian Williams a year ago; first-time tongue-tie.
runners.comment: Well behind I'd Go Maniac last time, but 9lb below last winning mark; tongue-tie on

runners.name: I'd Go Maniac
runners.spotlight: Bumper/AW handicap winner; second of 13 here (1m2f, good to firm) in May under Georgia King and has since twice made the frame under the same rider, the latest when third of seven at Epsom (1m4f, good to firm) last month; still unexposed on turf and respected back down in grade.
runners.comment: Running well of late under under Georgia King; still unexposed on turf and respected

runners.name: Market House
runners.spotlight: Versatile sort having won on turf, AW and over hurdles; 2lb lower than for his last Flat success but this trip looks sharp enough; Ruby Criscuolo rode a winner for the stable at Wolverhampton last month; yard also runs Wrist Art.
runners.comment: Versatile sort; 2lb lower than for his last Flat success but this trip looks sharp enough

runners.name: Wrist Art
runners.spotlight: Has run well on good to firm but looks best on a softer surface; either way a record of 2-49 sounds a note of caution; out of the weights.
runners.comment: Record of 2-49 sounds a note of caution; out of the weights

runners.name: Fast Steps
runners.spotlight: Latest defeat when sent off favourite here (1m2f, good to firm) a fortnight ago wasn't quite as bad as it looks, but his losing run is now up to 20 and his best form has come over shorter.
runners.comment: Losing run is now up to 20 and his best form has come over shorter

runners.name: Jodhpur Blue
runners.spotlight: 1-21; has been placed a few times on turf but his best form has come on the AW, albeit he was well held at Wolverhampton (1m4f) on Friday; others stronger.
runners.comment: Placed a few times on turf but his best form has come on the AW; others stronger

runners.name: Bloodhound
runners.spotlight: Ran with some credit on his return from 100 days off when fourth of 11 at Chepstow (1m2f, good to soft) seven weeks ago, but now 0-27 and is well out of the weights.
runners.comment: Ran with some credit last time, but is now 0-27 and well out of the weights

runners.name: Green Team
runners.spotlight: Third start for new yard when winning at Wolverhampton (1m4f, AW) under Grace Littmoden in May; 4lb rise fair enough and the return to turf shouldn't be a problem back from a short break; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Won under Grace Littmoden on the AW last time; return to turf shouldn't be a problem

races.race_name: Wasdell Group Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Rocsane
runners.spotlight: Inclined to hang on her first two runs and continued the steady progression when having Decem Carolinae behind at Yarmouth five weeks ago; a lot of years since her trainer had a 2yo win on turf but she sets the standard the newcomers are gunning for.
runners.comment: Continued the steady progression when having Decem Carolinae behind at Yarmouth; player

runners.name: Proper Naughty
runners.spotlight: 50,000gns yearling who's the first foal of a French 7f winner and holds a few sales race entries; trainer enjoyed a good spell with 2yos of late and she's interesting under Oisin Murphy (18-98 for the yard).
runners.comment: 50,000gns yearling; trainer enjoyed a good spell with 2yos of late and she's interesting

runners.name: Polly The Sniper
runners.spotlight: 1,000gns foal who's the first offspring of an unraced sister to two winners over hurdles; trainer has a 7% strike-rate with 2yos here; would want to see good support on debut before considering her.
runners.comment: 1,000gns foal who's the first offspring of an unraced sister to two winners over hurdles

runners.name: Lovely Dark Angel
runners.spotlight: 60,000euros foal, 70,000euros yearling who's the first offspring of a French 6f-7f winner; trainer's strike-rate with 2yos is up a touch this season and he's 26% with them here; she's a likely looking newcomer.
runners.comment: 60,000euros foal, 70,000euros yearling; stable 26% with 2yos here; likely looking newcomer

runners.name: Decem Carolinae
runners.spotlight: Just a fair debut at Yarmouth in late June (6f), when hitting a bit of traffic behind Rocsane (race won by subsequent Super Sprint winner Zigazig Ah); entitled to improve for a yard that's had a quiet year so far with juveniles.
runners.comment: Hit a bit of traffic behind Rocsane on debut; entitled to improve and is one to consider

runners.name: Purple Dream
runners.spotlight: Slowly away when finishing a remote last on her Tapeta debut 11 days ago; will need to leave that well behind for a trainer who's 2-23 with 2yos here.
runners.comment: Slowly away when finishing a remote last on her Tapeta debut 11 days ago; needs much more

runners.name: Star Bayside Boy
runners.spotlight: Stamina in her pedigree; never involved after a slow start on her 5f debut for Richard Hughes here seven weeks ago; prominent in the market that day, though, and interesting to see how she goes in the betting for her new yard (0-44 with 2yos here all told).
runners.comment: Well held on 5f debut here; interesting to see how she goes in the market for her new yard

races.race_name: Wasdell Group EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Night Shining
runners.spotlight: Was finishing fourth for the third consecutive time when filling that position on handicap debut at Kempton (6f, AW) last month; doesn't shape as though the drop to 5f is a positive, but her form still makes her a major player in this field; tongue-tie given a go.
runners.comment: Drop to 5f doesn't look a positive, but still a major player in this field; tongue-tie on

runners.name: Pilgrim's Progress
runners.spotlight: Twice runner-up on the AW at Lingfield (5f/6f), but failed to beat a rival back on turf there (6f, good to firm) nine days ago; however, the return to the minimum trip does look a positive so she may be worth chancing.
runners.comment: Failed to beat a rival last time but the return to 5f does look a positive; worth chancing

runners.name: Gris De Chine
runners.spotlight: Has shown ability in her four starts as when fourth of seven in a first-time tongue-tie at Ffos Las (5f, good; first start since wind surgery) last month; others are still preferred, though, with low-grade handicaps looking a better option.
runners.comment: Has shown ability in her four starts, but low-grade handicaps may be a better option

runners.name: Ardnamurchan
runners.spotlight: Sent off 40-1 for her Leicester debut (6f, good to firm) ten weeks ago, but ran well to be beaten less than 2l into fourth of ten (winner has gone in again since); absence is a slight concern, but she still makes more appeal than most.
runners.comment: Promising when fourth on her Leicester debut in May; makes more appeal than most

runners.name: Just Dreaming
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in two starts on the AW (5f/6f) more than 15 months apart (debut was for Mark Usher); best watched for now.
runners.comment: Well beaten in two starts on the AW more than 15 months apart; best watched for now

runners.name: Livvys Edge
runners.spotlight: 66-1 when a well-beaten sixth of seven on her Ffos Las debut (5f, good) last month (around 4l behind Gris De Chine).
runners.comment: Well beaten on her Ffos Las debut last month
runners.owner: Int Plywood (lmporters) Ltd And C Mason

runners.name: Flagraiser
runners.spotlight: Huge prices when tailed off at Chepstow (7f, good to firm) and here (1m2f, good to firm) last month; drops dramatically in trip and makes no appeal.
runners.comment: Tailed off in both starts last month; drops dramatically in trip and makes no appeal

runners.name: Yazoo
runners.spotlight: Had major issues at the start in his first two outings and achieved little when beaten 10l into second of three at Lingfield (6f, good to firm; first-time blinkers) 12 days ago; bred to be better than that, but best watched for now.
runners.comment: Achieved little when beaten 10l into second of three at Lingfield last time; best watched

races.race_name: Happy Birthday Tyne Patterson Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Saucy Jane
runners.spotlight: Made the most of her declining mark when regaining winning form off 2lb lower at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) last month; lost her race at the start at Bath a fortnight later and a major player if breaking on terms this time.
runners.comment: Lost her race at the start last time but won well at Thirsk the time before; major player
runners.owner: Nick Bradley Racing 16 And Jmr Partners

runners.name: Lahina Bay
runners.spotlight: Three-time course winner (5f/6f) whose form has been mixed since returning to turf in May, but this front-runner may enjoy the run of the race and she remains on a favourable mark; goes especially well on good to firm ground; much respected.
runners.comment: Three-time course winner; may enjoy the run of the race and remains on a favourable mark

runners.name: Q T Pie
runners.spotlight: Won a maiden over C&D (good) for the Kublers a year ago and only just beaten on her reappearance/stable debut at Goodwood (6f, soft) in June, but well beaten at Leicester (6f, good to firm) last month; may not want the ground this quick, but still a player if bouncing back in first-time cheekpieces.
runners.comment: C&D winner whose form has been up and down; a player if bouncing back; cheekpieces on

runners.name: Havana Halo
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden who showed ability in her early starts last year, but seems to have lost her way including in both outings since returning in June; Oisin Murphy regains the ride but the filly still needs a resurgence.
runners.comment: 0-7; seems to have lost her way and needs a resurgence

runners.name: Independent Expert
runners.spotlight: Eight-time winner in Ireland but all over 7f/1m, and three starts over 6f/7f for this yard have yielded little; takes another drop in class but best watched for now.
runners.comment: Three starts for this yard have yielded little; down in class but best watched for now

races.race_name: Talk Sport Classified Stakes

runners.name: Freedom Bay
runners.spotlight: Running well in this headgear lately, winning a 0-60 handicap at Bath (1m, good) in June and keeping on to finish a close third in a similar contest to this at Lingfield (1m, AW) three weeks ago; didn't stay 1m4f in one attempt but should be fine at this trip; player.
runners.comment: Running well in this headgear lately and should be fine at this trip; player

runners.name: Letsbeatsepsis
runners.spotlight: 0-16 but looked unlucky not to finish closer when third of nine in a 0-70 handicap at Epsom (8.5f, good to firm) last time; not certain to back that up but would be a player if he can.
runners.comment: 0-16; third in a 0-70 handicap last time and would be a player if he can back that up

runners.name: Tiger Beetle
runners.spotlight: On a losing run of 14 but ran with plenty of credit when third of nine in a 0-60 handicap at Chepstow (1m2f, good to firm) ten days ago; drops to this level for the first time and high on list.
runners.comment: Third in a handicap at Chepstow ten days ago; drops to this level for the first time

runners.name: Moonlit Cloud
runners.spotlight: On a losing run of 18 but does know how to win and drops below 0-60 level for the first time; each-way claims; stable also runs Maryland Star.
runners.comment: Does know how to win and drops below 0-60 level for the first time; each-way claims

runners.name: Maryland Star
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden who hinted at ability in a couple of maidens but hasn't built on it in handicaps, including when fitted with a hood last time; makes limited appeal despite the drop in grade.
runners.comment: 0-7; some ability in maidens but modest in handicaps; limited appeal despite drop in grade

runners.name: Time For Action
runners.spotlight: First and second in two nurseries at Bath (1m, soft) last October, but not much otherwise including in both starts since returning in June; drop in grade the one positive.
runners.comment: First and second in nurseries at Bath last October, but not much otherwise; down in grade

runners.name: Madame Passant
runners.spotlight: 0-5 but not disgraced in a couple of 0-55 handicaps; still unexposed and shortlisted with a first-time tongue-tie added to the usual hood.
runners.comment: 0-5 but not disgraced in a couple of 0-55 handicaps; still unexposed; tongue-tie on

runners.name: Kaaress
runners.spotlight: Landed a similar contest at Lingfield (1m2f, AW) in January, but that her only success in her last 25 starts; could go well but others preferred for the win.
runners.comment: Won a similar contest at Lingfield in January, but that her only win in her last 25 starts

runners.name: My O My
runners.spotlight: 0-11; has run with credit in a couple of fast-ground handicaps over this trip in recent months, but still looks up against it on these terms.
runners.comment: 0-11; has run with credit in a couple of handicaps, but looks up against it on these terms

runners.name: Elora Prince
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish gelding who ran with a bit of credit when fourth of ten in a similar contest at Ffos Las (1m2f, good) last time, but has yet to be placed in 12 starts; hood will need to make a difference.
runners.comment: Has yet to be placed in 12 starts; hood on

runners.name: Panthere Noir
runners.spotlight: Successfully dropped to this level when off the mark at the 17th attempt at Lingfield (1m2f, good to firm) on Saturday; major player if turning out again.
runners.comment: Off the mark at the 17th attempt at Lingfield on Saturday; major player

runners.name: Dora Vita
runners.spotlight: 0-9; may have been flattered when third of six in a 0-55 handicap at Leicester (1m, good to firm) 12 days ago; drops in grade but others are more convincing.
runners.comment: 0-9; may have been flattered last time; drops in grade but others are more convincing

races.race_name: Talk Sport Radio Handicap

runners.name: Havana Tobouggaloo
runners.spotlight: 0-11 but has performed with credit on all four starts this year for current trainer; back on the same mark as when beaten a neck at Bath (1m, good to soft) in April; first-time cheekpieces are now applied and she should run well.
runners.comment: 0-11 but has performed with credit on all four starts this year for current trainer

runners.name: Homme De Fer
runners.spotlight: Both wins have been over 7f on AW; looks in need of a drop in the weights and a drop back in trip on AW.
runners.comment: Looks in need of a drop in the weights and a drop back in trip on AW

runners.name: Flag Carrier
runners.spotlight: Both wins have been on AW; raced too freely on return to action when sixth of seven over C&D (good to firm) two weeks ago and needs to settle better to give himself a chance.
runners.comment: Raced too freely on return to action when sixth of seven over C&D two weeks ago

runners.name: Chilly Breeze
runners.spotlight: Sole success came in a Nottingham maiden in 2024 when trained by David Evans; switched yards this year and best run since when runner-up at Doncaster (1m, good to firm) 11 days ago; Billy Loughnane rides for the first time and he should be thereabouts.
runners.comment: Best run since winning maiden in 2024 when runner-up at Doncaster 11 days ago

runners.name: My Ambition
runners.spotlight: Placed on his first two runs this year but last two runs not so good; three of his four turf wins have been at Bath, and may be best to wait until he returns to that venue.
runners.comment: Placed on his first two runs this year but last two runs not so good

runners.name: Havana Club
runners.spotlight: Confirmed the promise of recent runs when scoring for the second time at Bath (1m, firm) last month; 5lb rise makes this tougher but holds place claims at least.
runners.comment: Confirmed the promise of recent runs when scoring for the second time at Bath last month

runners.name: Dark Rosa
runners.spotlight: Sole handicap success came at Wolverhampton (8.5f, AW) last November off 1lb higher, and she has returned to form in her last two starts; down to a career-low mark and holds place claims.
runners.comment: Sole handicap success came at Wolverhampton last November off 1lb higher

runners.name: Ararat
runners.spotlight: All five wins have been for previous trainers over 6f/7f; his two runs over 1m have not proved his stamina for the distance, but this does represent a class drop so all is not lost.
runners.comment: All five wins have been for previous trainers over 6f/7f

runners.name: Benavente
runners.spotlight: Previously trained in Ireland; all seven wins have been on AW, the latest being a claimer at Dundalk when last seen in March; probably best watched on stable debut unless the market suggests otherwise.
runners.comment: Previously trained in Ireland; all seven wins have been on AW, six at Dundalk
